name: 93449 · Pismo Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 93449 (Pismo Beach) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93449 (Pismo Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
